title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
The page continues the case-by-case description of the structure at infinity of moduli stacks, here genus 0 with 5 marked points. Formula (82) (printed (87) in the transcription) identifies the stack of 5-pointed stable genus-0 curves with unordered points as a quotient stack: M̂_{0,5} = [M̂^!_{0,5}/S_5] = [M̂_{0,I}/S_I], where |I| = 5. Here M̂^!_{0,5} ≅ M̄_{0,5}, the moduli of curves with numbered marked points, which is a smooth projective scheme over Z (the degree-5 del Pezzo surface).

The boundary of M̄_{0,5} has two kinds of strata. There are 10 boundary divisors D_{ij}, indexed by 2-element subsets {i,j} of I. There are 15 'critical points at infinity', the codimension-2 strata: these are the double points of the boundary, indexed by pairs of disjoint 2-subsets. S_I acts transitively on each set. So in the quotient stack there is exactly one boundary divisor and one boundary 'critical' point.

This is the same kind of bookkeeping (strata of each codimension, modulo automorphisms) that the next page carries out for M̂^!_{1,2}. There Grothendieck finds two boundary divisors and two critical points, with an incidence pattern. The purpose is to understand the 'multiplicité schématique à l'infini' as a union of smooth stacks M̂_G modulo graph automorphism groups, i.e. the stratification of M̄_{g,ν} by stable dual graphs, as a step toward the 'Lego/Teichmüller tower' programme.
errors: No mathematical error: 10 = C(5,2) boundary divisors, and 15 = 5·3 codimension-2 boundary points (choose the 'middle' point, then split the remaining four into two pairs). S_5 acts transitively on both sets.
